fields.description: Yas Riva Residences is Aldar’s canal-side apartment development on Yas Island. Six residential buildings offer studios through three-bedroom homes around landscaped shared spaces and The Pavilion, a communal building with a library and café.

research.community: Yas Riva Residences apartments · Yas Island
overview: The apartment collection has dedicated leisure and social facilities rather than the private docks associated with some original Yas Riva villas. Residents’ spaces include The Pavilion, pools and a waterfront promenade.

The published plans include accessible studio and one-bedroom Type B layouts, two-bedroom Type E, and three-bedroom Type B. Check the exact apartment drawing and accessibility specification before choosing a home.
research.locationNote: Along the Yas Island canal in Abu Dhabi. This apartment scheme is separate from the original 151 Yas Riva villas and the later Yas Riva Reserve villas; their prices, plans and completion dates do not apply here.
research.priceNote: The fact sheet lists AED 1.35m at launch. Current availability and pricing require a dated quotation for the selected apartment.
research.paymentNote: The fact sheet gives 65/35 with 5% booking. Two brokers corroborate 5% booking, 60% during construction and 35% at handover. Obtain dated instalments from the current reservation documents.
research.handoverNote: The project-specific fact sheet and corroborating broker pages give Q4 2029. This is an estimated handover window; the selected apartment’s contract and subsequent developer notices govern its delivery date.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: 950 homes: 138 studios, 372 one-bedroom, 422 two-bedroom and 18 three-bedroom apartments. This is the development mix, not current availability.

facts.label: Resident services
facts.value: Concierge, security, maintenance and wellness support are advertised. Their scope, booking arrangements and any additional charges require confirmation.

unresolved: Current stock, prices, parking allocations, service charges and dated payment instalments remain unconfirmed.
The launch size table reports averages without a clear internal-versus-balcony breakdown. Do not treat these as a selected apartment’s registered saleable area.
Official webpage introductory copy mentions Saadiyat Cultural District, conflicting with its title and project-specific brochure; that paragraph was excluded.
The official brochure includes stray Gardenia Bay furniture text. Furnishing package inclusions were therefore not assumed.
Some portals interchange Yas Riva villa and Residences apartment URLs or give conflicting payment plans. Only project-specific apartment documents and corroborated 65/35 terms were used.
